title: SandRidge Energy Inc 8-K Filing — Departure of Director
summary: SandRidge Energy, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 21, 2026, disclosing that director Randolph C. Read notified the Company on April 18, 2026, that he will not stand for re-election to the Board at the 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. The filing states his decision was not due to any disagreement with the Company regarding operations, policies, or practices.
key_points: Director Randolph C. Read will not stand for re-election at the 2026 Annual Meeting
Read's term will expire at the Annual Meeting; he will continue to serve until then
Decision was not due to any disagreement with the Company
Filing signed by Jonathan Frates, Executive Vice President and CFO
Company is incorporated in Delaware with ticker SD listed on NYSE
